subject: Delegated resale & co-sell SKU reconciliation — AtlasPartner
messages:
From: Ethan Rogers <ethan@atlaspartner.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Jun 2029 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Delegated resale & co-sell SKU mapping for AtlasPartner

Hi Naomi,

Thanks again for the intro last week — AtlasPartner is excited to move from exploration to a pilot for co-sell + delegated resale. Two asks from our side to keep momentum:

1) SKU reconciliation: we need a single authoritative mapping between Redwood SKUs (hosted API / dedicated) and our resell SKUs so finance can set pricing margins. I attached a spreadsheet with our initial mapping.
2) Delegated resale agreement: we'd like to review Redwood's standard reseller addendum (high level: revenue share, reporting cadence, DMCA/data handling). Can you share the latest draft or point me to the right contact?

We aim to start a small pilot (US region) with a handful of joint customers by July. Would love a 30-minute sync this week to align on owners and timelines.

Thanks,
Ethan Rogers
Head of Partnerships
AtlasPartner

Attachment: sku-recon-spreadsheet.csv (CSV, 42KB)
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Rogers <ethan@atlaspartner.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Jun 2029 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Delegated resale & co-sell SKU mapping for AtlasPartner

Ethan — thanks for the clear ask and the spreadsheet. Good to see you're targeting a July pilot; we can make that work.

Quick answers:
- SKU authoritative source: we'll use a reconciled feed from our billing team; Karthik is the internal owner and will run the mapping changes.
- Resale addendum: I don't have a final PDF in my inbox, but Ben (CC'd) manages partner contracts and will share the latest reseller addendum and a short redline summary.

Proposed immediate next steps:
- Karthik to ingest your CSV and produce a reconciled version (ETA 48 hours)
- Ben to send our resale addendum + a short list of negotiation points
- 30-min alignment call on Thursday (June 20) at 10:00 PT if that works for you — I'll send a calendar invite once you confirm.

High level asks from Redwood: we need clarity on:
- which customers you plan to onboard under delegated resale vs. co-sell (reporting distinction)
- whether AtlasPartner will require white-labeling or public reseller SKUs (affects catalog visibility)

Thanks — looking forward to moving quickly.

Naomi Feldman
Head of Alliances, Redwood Inference
naomi_feldman@redwood.com
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0123
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Jun 2029 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Delegated resale & co-sell SKU mapping for AtlasPartner

Karthik/Ben — forwarding AtlasPartner's CSV and flagging for priority: they want SKU reconciled and a reseller addendum for delegated resale. Key constraints: US-only pilot, small set of joint customers, go-live target July.

Karthik — can you ingest their sku-recon-spreadsheet.csv (attached) and produce a reconciled mapping that shows: Redwood SKU ID, Redwood SKU name, Suggested AtlasPartner resale SKU, Billing implications (metered vs. fixed). Aim for a tidy CSV back to them by EOD Thursday (48 hours).

Ben — please share the latest reseller addendum and call out 3 negotiation items you expect (our usual: revenue share floor, support entitlement, KYC/data residency notes). Also advise if Legal needs to own the call with AtlasPartner legal.

Attachment: sku-recon-spreadsheet.csv (forwarded)

Thanks — I'm penciling Thursday 10:00 PT for the 30-min alignment unless Ethan requests a different time.

Date: Thu, 20 Jun 2029 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Delegated resale & co-sell SKU mapping for AtlasPartner

Naomi/Ethan/Lisa/Karthik — attaching our reseller addendum (draft) and a quick redline summary. High-level:

1) Revenue share — standard band 15–25% depending on committed volume; for pilots we recommend a flat 20% to simplify billing.
2) Reporting cadence — monthly consolidated usage report, CSV export of customer-level usage; AtlasPartner should provide a list of delegated customers.
3) Support entitlements — delegated resale customers are supported via AtlasPartner first-line, Redwood provides second-line tech support under a consume-and-escalate model.

Karthik — I've left comments in the addendum where Legal historically pushes back (data handling clause and audit rights). If AtlasPartner needs tighter residency controls we can escalate to Legal.

Ethan — agreed on Thursday 10:00 PT for the alignment call. I'll include a brief agenda and share the DocuSign link post-call if we have alignment on the pilot terms.

Best,
Ben Carter
Head of Ecosystem Programs, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

Attachments: resale_agreement-draft.pdf (PDF, 120KB); resale_addendum_notes.txt (3KB)
